_readme: RESERVED WORDS (PDF2BIM_VECTOR_PROBE.md §58): printed words whose meaning the drawing states and a reader must not skip. EDITABLE; every entry cites WHO gave the meaning. Nothing here is inferred.

LUFTRAUM.meaning: an empty space across from the ground floor to the first (owner, 2026-11-25)
effect: no slab at this storey over the room region that holds the label (a slab opening)
not a floor area on this storey: no printed-area comparison
the room below keeps its height up to the next slab above the void
LUFTRAUM.witness: W-S58a: the model has no slab over the labelled point on the storey where the word is printed

DACHNEIGUNG.meaning: roof pitch in degrees, printed beside the roof section (DE-1 p2, mid-left: 'DACHNEIGUNG 22 GRAD')
effect: the roof planes of the model slope at <n> degrees (tolerance 1 degree)
DACHNEIGUNG.witness: W-S59c: model roof pitch (rise over half-span) equals the printed value within 1 degree
DACHNEIGUNG.source: printed on the drawing (DE-1 p2), read by OCR 2026-11-25
